name: Uncraft Basics
summary: Craft wool, quartz, clay, glowstone, ice and other packed blocks back into the materials you made them from.
logoPrompt: A crafting table with a white wool block on top that is coming apart into loose pieces of string
description: **Uncraft Basics adds crafting recipes that turn packed blocks back into their materials, for the times you crafted one block too many.**
- Wool of all 16 colours gives 4 string.
- Quartz block, quartz pillar and chiseled quartz block give 4 nether quartz each.
- Clay, snow, glowstone, amethyst, bricks, nether bricks and honeycomb blocks give back their 4 pieces.
- Blue ice gives 9 packed ice, packed ice 9 ice and dripstone block 4 pointed dripstone.
- Amounts match the vanilla recipes, so you never get more than went in.

Put the zip into the `datapacks` folder of your world (or pick it when you create a new world). Then put one block alone into a crafting grid. Each recipe shows up in the recipe book once you carry its block.
- Made for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21 and 1.21.1. It only adds recipes, so it is safe to add to or remove from an existing world.
- Works in singleplayer and on servers; players need nothing installed.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
